title: Double immunostaining for PIP2 and phosphorylated ERK
author: Hiraku Miyagi
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.9gxh3xn
materials: Cultivation of cells on cover slips See "Materials" to sterilize cover slips. Wash cells in a 60-mm dish with 3 mL of DPBS. Add 300 µL of Accumax (Funakoshi) to the dish. Incubate 10 min at 37° C in an incubator with 5% CO 2 . Suspend cells in 0.9 mL of DPBS containing 0.5 mM EDTA. Transfer this suspension to a 1.5 mL tube and count the number of cells using a hemocytometer. Dilute the cells to 2.5 x 10 4 cells/mL in DMEM. Place a sterilized cover slip in each well of a covered 24-well plate as needed. Then transfer the diluted cell suspension to each of those wells (400 µL/well). Leave the plate on the bench for 10 min. Place the plate in an incubator at 37° C with 5% CO 2 and cultivate for 12 hr. In order to starve the cells, replace the medium with 600 µL/well of culture medium without serum.

Labeling with fluorescent dye-conjugated ppERK antibodies Transfer cover slips from the 24-well plate to the humified box. Excess solution on cover slips must be blotted before placing them on the parafilm. Put 40 µL of Alexa647-conjugated anti-ppERK solution (1:300) on each cover slip. Incubate for 30 min at RT. Remove the antibody solution from the cover slips and then immediately transfer them to a covered 24-well plate to prevent drying. Rinse x1 and Wash x3 with HBSS.

Cultivation of cells on cover slips See "Materials" to sterilize cover slips. Wash cells in a 60-mm dish with 3 mL of DPBS. Add 300 µL of Accumax (Funakoshi) to the dish. Incubate 10 min at 37° C in an incubator with 5% CO 2 . Suspend cells in 0.9 mL of DPBS containing 0.5 mM EDTA. Transfer this suspension to a 1.5 mL tube and count the number of cells using a hemocytometer. Dilute the cells to 2.5 x 10 4 cells/mL in DMEM. Place a sterilized cover slip in each well of a covered 24-well plate as needed. Then transfer the diluted cell suspension to each of those wells (400 µL/well). Leave the plate on the bench for 10 min. Place the plate in an incubator at 37° C with 5% CO 2 and cultivate for 12 hr. In order to starve the cells, replace the medium with 600 µL/well of culture medium without serum.

steps.title: Activate cells with EGF
steps.instruction: Remove 300 µL medium from each well (leaving 300 µL), add 100 µL EGF solution (400 ng/mL in DMEM, giving a final concentration of 100 ng/mL) or add medium without ligand, and incubate 5 min at room temperature (RT).

steps.title: First fixation and permeabilization
steps.instruction: Fix and permeabilize cells in two sequential incubations.

substeps.instruction: Replace medium with 400 µL of 3 % paraformaldehyde (PFA) / NaF / Na₃VO₄; incubate 10 min at RT; rinse once and wash three times with HBSS.
Replace HBSS with 400 µL of 50 µg/mL digitonin in 3 % PFA / NaF / Na₃VO₄; incubate 10 min at RT; rinse once and wash three times with HBSS.

steps.title: First blocking
steps.instruction: Discard the buffer from the 24‑well dish and add 300 µL Blocking One‑P (Nacalai) to each well; block 30 min at RT.

steps.title: Incubate with anti‑PIP2 antibody
steps.instruction: Transfer cover slips to a humidified box on parafilm, blot excess solution, add 40 µL anti‑PIP₂ antibody diluted 1:600 in Blocking One‑P to each slip, incubate 30 min at RT, then immediately return slips to wells of a covered 24‑well plate; rinse once and wash three times with HBSS.

steps.title: Second fixation and permeabilization
steps.instruction: Perform a second fixation/permeabilization in two steps.

substeps.instruction: Replace medium with 400 µL of 3 % PFA / NaF / Na₃VO₄; incubate 10 min at RT; rinse once and wash three times with HBSS.
Replace HBSS with 400 µL of 0.01 % Triton X‑100 in 3 % PFA / NaF / Na₃VO₄; incubate 10 min at RT; rinse once and wash three times with HBSS.

steps.title: Second blocking
steps.instruction: Discard the buffer from the 24‑well dish and add 300 µL Blocking One‑P (Nacalai) to each well; block 30 min at RT.

steps.title: Incubate with TRITC‑conjugated antibody
steps.instruction: Transfer cover slips to a humidified box on parafilm, blot excess solution, add 40 µL TRITC‑conjugated anti‑mouse IgM antibody diluted 1:2400 in Blocking One‑P to each slip, incubate 30 min at RT, then immediately return slips to wells of the covered 24‑well plate; rinse once and wash three times with HBSS.

steps.title: Mount coverslips
steps.instruction: Place each cover slip on a glass slide with 4 µL Abberior mount solid, then store slides at 4 °C in the dark overnight.

steps.title: Acquire fluorescence images
steps.instruction: Capture images using an Olympus IX‑81 microscope equipped with an ORCA Flash4.0 (Hamamatsu) sCMOS camera and a 20× UPLSAPO objective; use filter set U‑MRFPHQ for TRITC and U‑M41008HQ for Alexa647; control acquisition with MetaMorph software and quantify fluorescence intensity with ImageJ.
